name: Takamiya Kureha
source:
She is [url=/c167744]Hajime[/url]'s childhood friend and fiancee who is a very high-class lady. At the same time, because she was raised in a rather sheltered environment, she barely has any common sense. These facts have led to Kureha being a very curious girl who enthusiastically jumps into everything that excites her. However, because she's been so spoiled since she was young, Kureha can't live without her butler [url=/c166987]Angelina[/url]. 

Her knowledge of sexual things is also very limited, as she believes that one could make a baby by kissing someone.

[From [url=https://asa-pro.com/ousama/character/]official website[/url]]
